description: Read an order directly from the escrow contract: parties, amount, status, deadlines and delivery hash. On escrow v3 the deadlines are the effective ones (they stop counting while the contract is paused) and a disputed order shows when anyone can close it by timeout. Orders from the old v2 escrow are read with escrowVersion 2.

escrowVersion.description: Escrow version the order lives in. Default: the current one. Use 2 for orders created before v3.

name: get_order_status
